text:
incident-bot: PAGER — billing.metering.token_counter: anomalous drop detected (12% lower than baseline over last 10m). Alert level P2. runbook: billing-ingest>recon-token-counts.

sophie: I'm on call. pulling dashboards now. can someone confirm whether API traffic is normal? @kevin @raj

kevin: API traffic looks normal from nginx metrics (requests/sec stable). generation logs show normal token emission. suspect drop is in downstream token-aggregation.

anika: tagging in SRE. I see a gap in the aggregator commit offsets to redis at ~2415012200. possible backlog/consumer stall.

raj: checking autoscaler events — no restarts. I see a spike of io_wait on node billing-agg-03 around 2415012100. could be GC or disk pressure.

kevin: confirmed: ingestion.v2 has an error where a recent commit made counter writes best-effort and some failures were suppressed. pushing a hotfix to re-enable retries.

maria-support: getting customer reports — a handful of customers received overage emails this morning; unclear if false positives. Support is triaging and holding notifications.

sophie: action items: 1) rollback the change that suppressed counter write errors (kevin), 2) run recon to reconcile token counts for last 2 hours (anika/raj), 3) pause outgoing overage notifications (maria). I'll coordinate comms.

kevin: rolling back now. command: 
```bash
kubectl -n billing rollout undo deployment ingestion-v2 --to-revision=5
```
Rolling back, monitoring.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started by kevin on ingestion-v2 (rev 6 -> 5). status: rollout in progress.

anika: starting fast-recon job (reconcile_token_counts) for window 2415010000..2415013600. will stream diffs here. using snapshot mode to avoid double-counting.

raj: kicked off emergency resync for redis offsets and increased consumer concurrency on agg-03. also increased ephemeral disk cache to avoid io_wait.

kevin: rollback finished. ingest logs show retries re-enabled and error 503 -> retried successfully. token writes starting to resume.

anika: recon job partial results: about 5k tokens undercounted across 12 customers; expected delta ~0.03% of daily volume. attaching top-level SQL diff: 
```sql
SELECT customer_id, sum(expected_tokens)-sum(recorded_tokens) as delta
FROM token_recon_tmp
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY delta DESC
LIMIT 10;
-- results: small integers, max delta 210 tokens for one customer
```

maria-support: support notes: impacted customers flagged for follow-up: cust_998, cust_421, cust_112. will hold automated overage emails and send manual notes once we confirm reconciliation.

sophie: summary update for execs: cause = aggregator suppressed write retries after a recent change; impact = short window of undercounting leading to false overage triggers for very small subset; mitigation = rollback + recon + pause notifications. next: postmortem and customer outreach plan. assigning owners: kevin (fix & PR), anika (recon + backfill), maria-support (customer comms).

billing-pager: NOTE: please create a follow-up ticket in BILLING-OPS with recon artifacts and add ETA for finished backfill.

sophie: assigning BILLING-OPS-4523. ETA for full reconciliation by EOD today (2415036000). I'll update channel when closed. :thumbsup:

maria-support: will prepare template for affected customers with clear reassurance and any credit offers.

kevin: opening PR to add test coverage for error handling on token writes. linking PR in ticket.

anika: recon job completed 2415013980. diffs applied, sanity checks passed. no additional anomalies.

sophie: handing off to kevin (next oncall) for overnight watch. kevin, please mark as acknowledged and close when you verify no regressions.

kevin: acknowledged. I have monitors on token_counter and ingress retries. will watch through night.

incident-bot: incident resolved: billing.metering.token_counter — status: mitigated. root cause under investigation; follow-up: postmortem assigned.

sophie: thanks all. filing postmortem and linking logs, recon output, and customer comms in the ticket.
